display.purpose: The single h1. No other role shares its size.

body.purpose: Intro copy and explanations, capped at 60ch.

label.purpose: Field labels, option labels, and control names.

panel-title.purpose: Small uppercase region labels; deliberately quieter than content.

action.purpose: Button labels and the compact intro line.

field-mobile.purpose: Input values; 16px on mobile to prevent iOS zoom.

micro.purpose: Hints, ratios, notices, and status text.

wordmark.purpose: Header identity, not a document heading.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: Panels and controls are flat; depth comes from tonal surfaces and 1px borders.

shadows.name: dropdown-lift
shadows.purpose: The only floating surface: the payload-type menu.

motion.purpose: Default deceleration for menus, pills, and active states.

motion.name: feedback
motion.purpose: Hover, border, and colour feedback on controls.

motion.name: glide
motion.purpose: The selection pill moving between payload types.

components.name: Panel
components.description: The only container on the page. Opaque black tray with a 16px radius, a hairline border, and a one-pixel top bevel.
components.html:
Palette

Colour controls sit on a flat tray.
components.css: .ds-panel { min-width: 0; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 16px; background: #0a0a0a; padding: 20px; color: #fff; font-family: "Maple Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0 0 12px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8a8a8a; } .ds-panel-copy { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.6; color: #adadad; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: One per preview panel. Signal Cyan fill, black label, pill shape.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 3v12"/><path d="m7 11 5 5 5-5"/><path d="M4 20h16"/></svg>Download PNG</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #00f0ff; border-radius: 999px; background: #00f0ff; color: #000; font: 600 13px/1 "Maple Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease, transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #64f6ff; border-color: #64f6ff; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00f0ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Raised neutral action beside the primary export.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-secondary"><svg width="15" height="15" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="9" y="9" width="11" height="11" rx="2"/><path d="M15 5.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 0 12.5 3H6a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v6.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 0 6.5 14"/></svg>Copy PNG</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 7px; min-height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); border-radius: 999px; background: #101010; color: #fff; font: 600 13px/1 "Maple Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; cursor: pointer; transition: background 120ms ease, border-color 120ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #161616; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.45); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #00f0ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Recessed field with a 3:1 border and a cyan focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font: 500 12px/1.5 "Maple Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; color: #adadad; } .ds-field { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); border-radius: 10px; background: #050505; color: #fff; font: 400 16px/1.4 "Maple Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; outline: none; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: #7a7a7a; } .ds-field:focus { border-color: #00f0ff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,240,255,0.12); }

components.name: Selected Option
components.description: Radio row with a miniature shape glyph. Selection is a solid cyan fill with black text and a black check.
components.css: .ds-option { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 42px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #00f0ff; border-radius: 10px; background: #00f0ff; color: #000; font: 500 13px/1.3 "Maple Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; cursor: pointer; } .ds-option svg { flex: 0 0 auto; color: #000; } .ds-option-label { flex: 1 1 auto; } .ds-option-check { color: #000; font-size: 13px; }

components.name: Colour Swatch
components.description: Preset colour control with a 3.5px white selection ring and a difference-blended check.
components.css: .ds-swatch { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #0a0a0a, 0 0 0 3.5px #ffffff; cursor: pointer; } .ds-swatch-check { color: #fff; mix-blend-mode: difference; font-size: 12px; }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Measured state. A static green LED and white state when contrast passes, amber when a region is below 3:1.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 31px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.3); border-radius: 999px; background: #050505; color: #adadad; font: 400 11px/1.5 "Maple Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; } .ds-status-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #34d399; } .ds-status-label { color: #fff; font-weight: 600; } .ds-status-ratio { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Preview Stage
components.description: Square viewfinder for the code. 16px stage, 20px black mat, inset hairline and vignette, two-module quiet zone inside.
components.css: .ds-stage { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 100%; max-width: 400px; margin-inline: auto; aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; padding: 20px; border-radius: 16px; background: #000; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.12), inset 0 0 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.9); } .ds-stage-qr { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; color: #000; font: 700 48px/1 "Maple Mono", ui-monospace, monospace; }

narrative.overview:
The studio is one instrument on a dark bench. The page is a single centred column of black trays, each with a 16-pixel radius and a hairline edge, stacked in the order the work happens: choose the payload, watch the code, then tune its shape, colour, and logo. Cyan is the signal: the wordmark, the active choice, the primary export, links, and focus. A white code sits on a black matted viewfinder inside its tray, with a measured status pill above it.

This is the cadd240 visual world, restored. The centred stack, full-cyan selection bars, pill exports, large centred wordmark, and matted code are the signature. Later work added debounced rendering, a mobile quick-action bar, WCAG contrast tokens, and stronger type. This is an Operate surface, so familiar affordances stay familiar: native radio semantics, native colour pickers, native file input, standard download buttons.
keyCharacteristics: AMOLED black page with opaque near-black trays, a hairline edge, and a one-pixel top bevel. No blur or glow.
One centred 45rem column; the payload, preview, shapes, palette, and logo trays stack with 20 to 24-pixel gaps.
One cyan signal used for the wordmark, selection, the primary export, links, and focus.
Pill buttons, 10-pixel controls, 16-pixel trays, circular swatches.
A black matted viewfinder with a two-module quiet zone inside the code.
Every styling decision reports a measurable consequence.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Cyan marks the wordmark, the active choice, the primary export, links, and focus. Selection is a solid cyan fill with black text. Cyan never becomes body copy, a decorative border, or a background wash.

rules.name: The Measurement Rule
rules.body: A colour failure is amber, not red, because the user is tuning a value and can fix it. Rose is reserved for something that did not run at all.

rules.name: The Opaque Glass Rule
rules.body: The trays carry the cadd240 glass-panel silhouette, but the material is opaque. No backdrop blur, translucent white overlay, gradient sheen, or coloured glow. Depth is the step from #000000 to #0a0a0a plus one hairline.

rules.name: The Readout Rule
rules.body: Any number that can change while the user works is set in tabular figures: contrast ratios, byte counts, matrix size, version, and error level.

rules.name: The No-Costume Rule
rules.body: Monospace is used because the interface is full of measured values, not to signal that the product was made by developers. Prose still gets a 66ch measure and 1.6 leading.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat. A shadow appears only when it explains a physical layer; here that means an inset hairline or vignette, never a cast shadow.

dos: Do keep the centred single-column stack; it is the cadd240 composition.
Do use cyan for selection, the wordmark, links, focus, and the one primary export.
Do show the measured contrast ratio next to each colour control and in the status pill.
Do keep a light quiet zone in the preview and every export. This studio uses two modules.
Do use 38% white for control borders and 48% for hover borders so controls clear the 3:1 non-text contrast floor.
Do use tabular numerals for any value that updates while the user types.
Do keep the sensitive-payload summary free of Wi-Fi passwords and email bodies.
Do collapse grids by intrinsic size so 200% text never truncates a label.
donts: Don't add blur, translucent white washes, gradients, cast shadows, or coloured glow; the glass-panel silhouette is opaque here.
Don't split the workbench into two desktop columns; the single centred stack is the identity.
Don't fill inactive options or secondary buttons with cyan; it erases the primary-action hierarchy.
Don't use a rounded chip for a control that reads better as a field, a row, or a circle.
Don't use Unicode glyphs or emoji as icons; the icon set is drawn at a 1.6px stroke on a 24-unit grid.
Don't claim a code is scan-verified when only contrast was checked; say "Contrast passes" and ask the user to test-scan before printing.
